Bulk supply point
nodes.description: Steps 132 kV down to the sub-transmission voltage feeding primaries.

nodes.label: Capacity assessment
nodes.description: Headroom / capacity figures for a substation from a heat map or DFES report.

nodes.label: Circuit
nodes.description: A line, cable or switch between two nodes.

nodes.label: Country
nodes.description: The country covered by national datasets: Great Britain, the scope of the catalogue.

nodes.label: Demand forecast
nodes.description: Forecast peak demand at a substation for one future year.

nodes.label: Distribution area
nodes.description: The region in which one DNO holds its distribution licence (a DNO licence area).

nodes.label: Distribution project
nodes.description: A project connected to a distribution network; one row of a DNO's Embedded Capacity Register.

nodes.label: Flow observation
nodes.description: A time-stamped power-flow measurement at a substation or network group.

nodes.label: Grid supply point
nodes.description: Where the distribution network takes power from the transmission network. It sits in one transmission area and in one or more distribution areas. Its transmission side (400 kV or 275 kV, plus 132 kV in Scotland) is owned by a transmission owner, and large projects in the TEC register connect there.

nodes.label: Network operator
nodes.description: An organisation that holds an Ofgem licence for part of the UK electricity system.

nodes.label: Node
nodes.description: An electrical connection point within a substation, identified by an LTDS node code. Tees and project ends belong to no substation.

nodes.label: Organisation
nodes.description: A body that runs part of the network, publishes data about it or issues a standard, e.g. a network operator, a government department or a regulator.

nodes.label: Primary substation
nodes.description: Steps down to the high-voltage (HV) network that feeds local secondary substations and large customers.

nodes.label: Project
nodes.description: A generation, storage or demand project connected (or contracted to connect) to the network, at a substation or directly onto a circuit.

nodes.label: REPD project
nodes.description: A project in the government's Renewable Energy Planning Database: the planning side (status, dates, operator).

nodes.label: Seasonal rating
nodes.description: The rating of a circuit in one season.

nodes.label: Service area
nodes.description: The polygon of the area supplied by a substation.

nodes.label: Site
nodes.description: A physical location where network equipment is installed. One site can host several substation roles, such as a BSP and a primary.

nodes.label: Substation
nodes.description: The equipment at a site that performs one function in the network: a GSP, BSP or primary, or a switching station. A site with several functions has one substation per function.

nodes.label: Substation load
nodes.description: Observed peak demand at a BSP or primary substation for one year, with the DNO's 5-year forecast and the firm capacity it is compared against (LTDS Table 3).

nodes.label: Switching station
nodes.description: A substation without transformers: it connects, splits or reconfigures circuits at a single voltage.

nodes.label: System operator
nodes.description: Plans the UK transmission system and balances supply and demand in real time. Owns no network assets. Manages transmission connections and publishes the TEC register and ETYS.

nodes.label: Temporal nature
nodes.description: What the time dimension of a dataset means.

nodes.label: Transformer
nodes.description: Transforms voltage between an HV node and an LV node.

nodes.label: Transformer substation
nodes.description: A substation with one or more transformers that step voltage up or down between two or more voltage levels.

nodes.label: Transmission area
nodes.description: A region in which one transmission owner holds the onshore transmission licence.

nodes.label: Transmission owner
nodes.description: Owns and maintains the onshore transmission network in one transmission area. Operates it on the system operator's instructions.

nodes.label: Transmission project
nodes.description: A project holding a Transmission Entry Capacity (TEC) agreement with the system operator; listed in the TEC register.

nodes.label: Typical voltages
nodes.description: The voltage levels that one type of transformer substation uses on one side, in a group of distribution areas.

nodes.label: category
nodes.description: e.g. Gen inverter headroom.

nodes.label: connected to circuit
nodes.description: Circuit the project connects onto directly.

nodes.label: connection site
nodes.description: Where the project connects.

nodes.label: demand forecast
nodes.description: Forecast peak demand for each of the next 5 years.

nodes.label: describes
nodes.description: A network class whose instances the dataset lists, e.g. busbar:GridSupplyPoint.

nodes.label: ECR project ID
nodes.description: The publisher's project ID, where the ECR has one (NPG).

nodes.label: end 1 node
nodes.description: Node on end 1 (HV side).

nodes.label: end 2 node
nodes.description: Node on end 2 (LV side).

nodes.label: end 3 node
nodes.description: Node on end 3, three-winding transformers only.

nodes.label: energy source
nodes.description: e.g. Solar, Wind, Biofuel - Landfill Gas.

nodes.label: firm capacity
nodes.description: Demand the substation can carry with its largest transformer or circuit out of service (N-1), in loadUnit.

nodes.label: forecast
nodes.description: Values for future years.

nodes.label: forecast value
nodes.description: Forecast peak demand, in the loadUnit of the substation load.

nodes.label: gate
nodes.description: Connections-reform queue gate.

nodes.label: has role
nodes.description: A substation function performed at the site.

nodes.label: host transmission owner
nodes.description: The transmission equivalent of a distribution area: the TO whose network the project connects to.

nodes.label: in distribution area
nodes.description: Empty for ENW substations, as ENW has a single distribution area.

nodes.label: in transmission area
nodes.description: The transmission area the substation sits in. Required for GSPs.

nodes.label: load unit
nodes.description: Unit of maxDemand, demand forecasts and firmCapacity; DNOs publish either.

nodes.label: local path
nodes.description: Path of the copy of the file in the Busbar repository.

nodes.label: maximum demand
nodes.description: Observed peak demand, in loadUnit.

nodes.label: minimum load scaling factor
nodes.description: Minimum demand as a share of maximum demand.

nodes.label: normally open
nodes.description: Open in normal operation: carries no current and is treated as a break.

nodes.label: observed year
nodes.description: Year of the observed peak, e.g. 2024/25.

nodes.label: parent company
nodes.description: Company that owns the licence holder.

nodes.label: power factor
nodes.description: Power factor at the observed peak.

nodes.label: REPD Ref ID
nodes.description: Stable across releases.

nodes.label: season
nodes.description: e.g. winter, summer. Only some DNOs split substation loads by season.

nodes.label: side
nodes.description: input: upstream, higher-voltage side; power can flow back out of it when local generation exceeds demand. output: downstream, lower-voltage side.

nodes.label: snapshot
nodes.description: The state of the network or of a register on the publication date.

nodes.label: substation type
nodes.description: The class of transformer substation the voltages apply to, e.g. busbar:GridSupplyPoint.

nodes.label: supplied by
nodes.description: Next substation upstream (primary -> BSP -> GSP).

nodes.label: technology
nodes.description: e.g. Photovoltaic, Battery, Engine (combustion / reciprocating).

nodes.label: time series
nodes.description: Measurements over a past period, given by dct:temporal.

nodes.label: unit
nodes.description: Unit of the values of a numeric property.

nodes.label: voltage end 1
nodes.description: End 1 (HV side).

nodes.label: voltage end 2
nodes.description: End 2 (LV side).

nodes.label: voltage end 3
nodes.description: End 3, three-winding transformers only.

nodes.label: voltage
nodes.description: On a substation load: voltage of the busbar the load is measured at. On typical voltages: one value per voltage level.

nodes.label: voltages
nodes.description: Voltage levels at the substation; one value per level.

nodes.label: CaptureSpecification
nodes.description: Git-managed instructions for observing a source catalogue; not an observation or a publisher edition.

nodes.label: Catalogue observation
nodes.description: A successful local observation of catalogue metadata, not a publisher dataset edition.

nodes.label: Curated catalogue
nodes.description: A catalogue whose selection, descriptions and publication history are maintained by a curator, distinct from observed source catalogues.

nodes.label: Catalogue observation record
nodes.description: A record of an acquisition outcome, including failed attempts. Only successful captures have snapshot graphs.

nodes.label: Publishing portal
nodes.description: A public publishing service with a stable identity independent of its current software or hostname.

nodes.label: TrackedCatalog
nodes.description: A source catalogue whose representation Busbar captures.

nodes.label: API key variable
nodes.description: Name of the environment variable holding the portal's API key. Never the key itself.

nodes.label: endpoint
nodes.description: HTTPS endpoint from which to capture a complete catalogue representation.

nodes.label: iriRepairCount
nodes.description: Number of malformed publisher IRIs resolved and percent-encoded in the TriG projection. Original response bytes remain unchanged.

nodes.label: maintained by
nodes.description: Organization responsible for maintaining the catalogue. This is distinct from dataset authorship, ownership and publisher responsibility.

nodes.label: portalOperator
nodes.description: Organization responsible for the publishing portal.

nodes.label: publisher catalogue identifier
nodes.description: Original publisher catalogue URI, preserved as metadata on the canonical catalogue in the viewer projection.

nodes.label: publisher catalogue title
nodes.description: Original publisher title retained separately from the curated display name.

nodes.label: tracks source dataset
nodes.description: The publisher's catalogue entry that a curated series follows; not an identity statement.
